title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.21 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard remaster captures a smoking Other One → Eyes of the World transition and a stellar China Doll with crystal‑clear instrument separation.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the pristine, newly‑remastered soundboard source, noting clean vocal and instrumental separation that lets the band’s interplay shine. Musically the show is highlighted by an explosive The Other One jam that folds into a spacey Eyes of the World and a superb China Doll, making this set one of the season’s standouts.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (average 4.7 stars) and emphasize both superb recording quality and outstanding performances, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered soundboard with very clean instrument separation, crisp vocals and no notable drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transition from The Other One jam into Eyes of the World, building a spacey vibe that culminates in an outstanding China Doll; overall pacing is tight and energetic.
